protocol_title: Non-Kinase Enzyme Expansion Template for Carbonic Anhydrase 2 Zn
description: Planning template for adding a non-kinase enzyme family to the existing blind/OOD/smoke governance pattern. Primary candidate is Carbonic_Anhydrase_2_Zn; Dihydrofolate Reductase, Fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1, and L-Lactate Dehydrogenase A Chain remain secondary fallback references only.

sets.title: Core Blind Set
sets.purpose: Primary non-kinase enzyme blind performance set for the first CA2 family extension.

sets.title: Expanded OOD Set
sets.purpose: Secondary non-kinase enzyme OOD set for CA2 under the same governance rules used elsewhere in the package.

sets.title: Operational Smoke Set
sets.purpose: Optional fast reproducibility support set for the first non-kinase enzyme family extension.

implementation_notes: Do not promote this template to a runnable spec until the target packet, ligand reference packet, ligand meta packet, and eval split packet exist.
Reuse the current blind/OOD/smoke governance pattern instead of inventing family-specific acceptance rules.
Treat Dihydrofolate Reductase, Fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1, and L-Lactate Dehydrogenase A Chain as fallback references until they receive their own ligand governance assets.
Make the first CA2 pass explicit about whether it is governance-only or already claims metal-aware scoring behavior.

The current template uses EGFR_KINASE as a target-level placeholder for the inherited fit-donor path only. CA2 ligand packets are intentionally decoupled from that donor placeholder; replace or freeze this policy before any runnable CA2 execution.
